claims.claim: The complete Curve block improves ranking over the same-budget raw three-world response features.
claims.evidence: DeepSeek: +0.0153 AUROC, CI [+0.0070,+0.0235]. Same-runtime Qwen recompute: +0.0107, CI [-0.0032,+0.0230].
claims.status: supported on DeepSeek; suggestive but not separately significant on current-runtime Qwen

claims.claim: Input normalization is the specific source of the gain.
claims.evidence: DeepSeek no-normalization: +0.0014 versus Full, CI [-0.0042,+0.0070]; AUPRC falls from .8653 to .8608. Qwen no-normalization: -0.0055 versus Full, CI [-0.0152,+0.0042].
Removing it lowers Full AUROC by .0042 DeepSeek and .0044 Qwen, but both CIs cross zero.

claims.claim: Direction information has unique incremental value.
claims.evidence: Removing it lowers Full AUROC by .0035 DeepSeek and .0019 Qwen, but both CIs cross zero.

claims.claim: The original 17-dim three-world baseline is an unfair or weakened comparator.
claims.evidence: It uses the same 2,050/1,735 items, folds, labels, parser and HGB architecture.
Both cohorts come from FinQA dev_train and Qwen data was repeatedly used in prior development.
